sentences.text: Felicity Kendall Huffman -LRB- born December 9 , 1962 -RRB- is an American film , stage , and television actress .	film	film	stage	stage (theatre)	television	Television program
Huffman began her acting career in theatre and in the 1990s also had many supporting roles in film and television .	film	film	television	Television program

She starred as executive producer Dana Whitaker in the critically acclaimed ABC comedy-drama Sports Night from 1998 to 2000 , which earned her a Golden Globe Award nomination .	executive producer	executive producer	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	Sports Night	Sports Night	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award

She is best known for her role as Lynette Scavo in the long-running ABC comedy-drama Desperate Housewives -LRB- 2004 -- 2012 -RRB- , for which she earned a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series for the debut season of the series and three Screen Actors Guild Awards overall .	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	Lynette Scavo	Lynette Scavo	Desperate Housewives	Desperate Housewives	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series	Screen Actors Guild Awards	Screen Actors Guild Awards

Huffman drew critical praise for her performance as a transgender woman in the independent film Transamerica -LRB- 2005 -RRB- .	film	film	transgender woman	transgender woman	Transamerica	Transamerica (film)

The role earned her a Golden Globe Award , Independent Spirit Award , National Board of Review , and an Academy Award nomination for Best Actress .	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award	Independent Spirit Award	Film Independent Spirit Awards	National Board of Review	National Board of Review	Academy Award	Academy Award

Huffman has also starred in such films as Reversal of Fortune -LRB- 1990 -RRB- , The Spanish Prisoner -LRB- 1997 -RRB- , Magnolia -LRB- 1999 -RRB- , Path to War -LRB- 2002 -RRB- , Georgia Rule -LRB- 2007 -RRB- , Phoebe in Wonderland -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , Rudderless -LRB- 2014 -RRB- and Cake -LRB- 2014 -RRB- .
